purpose: Restore the frozen M0-01 coverage contract by making the scheduled coverage campaign execute both registered xtask public-fixture verdicts and the owned controlled-execution verdict suite.

scope.registered_surface: tools/xtask scheduled EG-COVERAGE target selection and its public foundational policy fixtures

coverage_target_selection.before: cargo llvm-cov selected only --test foundational_scope_activation for total and changed-code reports
coverage_target_selection.after: cargo llvm-cov selects --test foundational_scope_activation and --bin xtask for both total and changed-code reports
coverage_target_selection.owner_scope_rationale: The registered xtask tooling scope owns controlled child process-group, descriptor, bounded wait, termination, reap, capture, and typed verdict behavior. Its existing owner tests prove those public outcomes; the fixture suite proves quality workflow invocation, gate selection, evidence, and policy outcomes. Both are required to measure the registered scope rather than only its outer workflow fixture.

unchanged: EXT-only placement of EG-COVERAGE, PR and pre-commit gate selection, registered timeouts, detector version, retries, result semantics, evidence schema, and immutable attempt retention
application scope, dependencies, unsafe-code policy, and Release 1 qualification status

detection_gained: scheduled coverage now measures the controlled-execution owner verdicts for exact stdout and stderr capture, launch and nonzero outcomes, deadline and cancellation cleanup, descriptor closure, descendant reconciliation, process-group reaping, and bounded capture failures
black-box policy fixtures reject removal of either owner-test target and reject drift of every frozen M0-01 coverage threshold

the escaped-descriptor deadline verdict fixture uses one bounded owned datagram acknowledgement: the escaped descendant signals only after it owns the retained descriptors, and the direct child exits only after that acknowledgement
the same coverage campaign retains workflow-level fast, PR, EXT, not-selected, missing-tool, and immutable-evidence verdict coverage
detection_lost: none; the prior fixture target remains selected and every frozen threshold, stage, timeout, detector, and result rule is retained

migration.from: coverage reports counted 3,813 covered lines out of 5,578 on clean current main because they omitted the registered owner verdict suite
migration.to: coverage reports run the fixture and owner targets together under the same pinned cargo-llvm-cov invocation and preserve separate total and changed-code reports; the escaped-descriptor regression fixture uses a bounded Unix-datagram readiness acknowledgement instead of two-sided file polling
migration.policy_guard: the policy gate requires the owner target in both coverage invocations and exact retained threshold values

retained_red_clean_main.failure: EG-COVERAGE fell below the frozen line and branch baselines; this failure remains retained.

pre_record_green_committed_sha.reason: clean local source identity is diagnostic only; trusted CI and independent review remain required.

retained_failed_exact_sha.failure: The changed-code coverage campaign failed while `returns_a_bounded_deadline_failure_when_an_escaped_descendant_retains_capture_descriptors` reported that its escaped descendant did not complete the file-polling readiness handshake. This attempt remains retained as the regression reproducer; it was not retried on the same revision.

evidence.dual_run: The retained clean-main red run used the former fixture-only target. The retained committed-SHA green run used the fixture plus owner target under the same EXT profile, pinned detector, and thresholds. The retained failed exact-SHA run exposed a file-polling fixture race under changed-code instrumentation. A final exact-SHA EXT run is required after the bounded readiness-protocol revision is committed.

approval_status: pending independent review; no approval is claimed by this local evidence
qualification_status: Implemented candidate only; no Release 1 target is Qualified by this change.
